name: Terena
description: An elven princess of Ruadach who seeks Taradomnu root to cure her poisoned father.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terena uses Taradomnu herbs to make a Circle of Protection that reflects Beothach's death magic and kills him.
timeline.quote: making her brother's death magic rebound back onto himself, killing him.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Gathering the Taradomnu , by Mark Shepherd". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terena finds her father assassinated but is pregnant, allowing her to take the throne for herself and her half-human child.
timeline.quote: which allows her to take the throne for herself and her half-human child according to the letter of the law.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Gathering the Taradomnu , by Mark Shepherd". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
